results.question: What is the treatment for Milk Fever in buffaloes?
results.answer:
**म्हैसांमध्ये दुधावरील तपाकळी (मिल्क फिव्हर) हा कॅल्शियम कमी झाल्यामुळे होणारा रोग आहे आणि त्यातून पुनरागमनासाठी शिरेच्या आत ३००–४०० मि.ली.** **कॅल्शियम बोरो-ग्लुकोनेट** द्यावे लागते; सोबतच **विटामिन डी३** स्वरूपात इंजेक्शनही दिले जाते.

**लक्षणे:**
- व्यानेनंतर साधारण ७२ तासांच्या आत उद्भवतात — गोंधळाची अवस्था, हालचाली बिघडणे, पाय व डोकात थरथरणे, प्राणी खाली बसतो व डोका बाजूकडे वाकतो; शेवटी धूमकेतू स्थिती येऊ शकते.

**उपचार:**
- शिरांतून **कॅल्शियम बोरो-ग्लुकोनेट** ३००–४०० मि.ली. द्या.
- **विटामिन डी३** इंजेक्शन स्वरूपात दे.
- गरज असेल तर पशुवैद्यकाचा मार्गदर्शनाखाली चांगली संभालन, मोकळे वातावरण व सतत निरीक्षण ठेवा.

**प्रतिबंध/नियंत्रण:**
- काही प्रमाणात चुना पाण्याचे मिसळणारे वापर हे घडामोडी कमी करू शकते (दस्तऐवजात याचा उल्लेख आहे).
- नियमित पोषक व्यवस्थापन व पशुवैद्यकाच्या सल्ल्यानुसार गर्भाधोरणी नंतरची काळजी घेतली तर घटना कमी होते.

अधिक नेमकी मात्रा, ओलांडणारी लक्षणे किंवा कोणते औषध वापरायचे, याबद्दल आपल्या जवळच्या पशुवैद्यकाशी त्वरित संपर्क साधा.

Awareness among animal keepers regarding the diet of cows and buffaloes during pregnancy [गरोदरपणा] is very important. The last month of pregnancy [गरोदरपणा] is considered very important for cows and buffaloes because the growth [वाढ] of the calf [वासरू] in the womb is about 35% in the first six to seven months, while it is more than 65% in the last month. After eight months of pregnancy [गरोदरपणा], the animal should be given a supplementary feed [पूरक आहार] (ambon) along with a full stomach of fodder [चारा]. For the body, two to three kilos of feed [खाद्य/चारा]/pallet should be increased at a rate of one and a half to two kilos, increasing it by 300-350 grams every fifteen days. This is because the increased feed [खाद्य/चारा] increases the fat in the body of buffaloes and cows, and after calving [व्याने], cows and buffaloes use this fat for milk production [दूध उत्पादन]. Accordingly, cows and buffaloes should be given low-fiber and high-energy feed [खाद्य/चारा] during the last month of pregnancy [गरोदरपणा]. On the advice of experts, 30 to 50 grams of mineral mixture [खनिज मिश्रण] should be given daily. An important point to note is that there should be no sudden changes in the daily diet of pregnant cows and buffaloes. It is necessary for the animal keeper to take all kinds of care regarding the diet of cows and buffaloes during pregnancy [गरोदरपणा]. From the seventh month onwards, for the rapid growth [वाढ] of the fetus, especially for the growth [वाढ] of their bones, there is a great need for calcium [कॅल्शियम] and phosphorus [स्फुरद]. Reduced concentrations of blood [रक्त] bicarbonate compromise the buffering capability associated with the bicarbonate system [पद्धत/प्रणाली], which may be critical during summer. वासरांना पहिली लस म्हणजे रोगप्रतिकारशक्ती मिळवण्यासाठी दिलेली लसीकरणाची सुरुवात साधारण चार महिन्यांच्या वयापासून केली जाते; खूप लहान वासरूच्या अवस्थेत (जन्मांतर फक्त काही दिवस/आठवडा) ही लस शिफारशीनुसार देणे दस्तऐवजांत उल्लेखित नाही.

**लसीकरण वेळापत्रक:**
- खुर व तोंड रोग: **४ महिन्यां पासून** पहिली मात्रा, एक महिन्यानंतर बूस्टर, त्यानंतर छ-महिनेअंतराने पुढील मात्रा
- अँथ्रॅक्स: **४ महिन्यां पासून** पहिली मात्रा, प्रत्येकी वर्षातुन (एंडेमिक भागात)
- ब्रुसॅलोसिस: **४ ते ८ महिन्यांचे** केवळ मादी वासरांसाठी; आयुष्यात एकदाच
- थायलेरीओसिस: **३ महिन्यांपासून**; संकरीत व परदेशी जातींसाठी, जीवनभर एकदाच
- हेमरेजिक सप्टिशिमिया व काळपुळी रोग: साधारण **६ महिन्यांपासून** पहिली मात्रा; एंडेमिक भागात दरवर्षी पुढील मात्रा

**इतर महत्त्वाचे मुद्दे:**
- जन्मानंतर ६ तासांच्या आत पुरेसे कोलॉस्ट्रम देणे आवश्यक, कारण यामुळे नवजात वासरांना क्षणिक प्रतिबंधक्षमता मिळते
- दस्तटी टाळण्यासाठी वासरांना स्वच्छ व कोरडे वातावरण ठेवा

**स्रोत: Animal Health and Nutrition Extension (MANAGE)** आणि **Handbook of Good Dairy Husbandry Practices (NDDB)**

मांसासाठी जास्त आणि वेगाने वाढणाऱ्या जाती म्हणून **ऊसमनबाडी** व **कोकण कण्याळ** या दोन जाती दिसतात, कारण या दोन्ही जातींत मोठे वजन आणि चांगली उत्पादन क्षमता नोंदविली आहे.

**उपलब्ध जातींची माहिती (वाढ व ताकीदीनुसार):**
- ऊसमनबाडी: महाराष्ट्रातील कोरड्या भागात चांगली वाढते; पिल्लूंच्या जमिनीचे द्वैतीय (ट्विन) प्रमाण सुमारे ५०–६०% आढळले आहे, निवड पद्धतीने हे प्रमाण ७०–७५% पर्यंत नेता येते, आणि ही जात मटणीसाठी बोलली आहे.
- कोकण कण्याळ: एक वर्षाच्या शेळीचा नर सुमारे २५ कि.ग्रा. व महिला सुमारे २१ कि.ग्रा. वजनाची नोंद आहे; पूर्ण वाढलेला नर सरासरी ५० कि.ग्रा. आणि महिला ३२ कि.ग्रा. इतका वजनधारक सांगितला आहे; दुहेरी (ट्विन) जन्म दर सुमारे ४०% आहे, रोगमुक्तता कमी, आणि अंतर-प्रजनन काळ ८ महिने आहे.

तुम्हाला फक्त मांसासाठी जात हवी आहे की दूधासाठीदेखील काहीशी जात हवी आहे?

**स्रोत: डॉ. बाळासाहेब सावंत कोकण कृषी विद्यापीठ, दापोली २०२५; महात्मा फुले कृषी विद्यापीठ (एम.पी.के.व्ही.), राहुरी; डॉ. पंजाबराव देशमुख कृषी विद्यापीठ, अकोला**

results.question: Paramparik nangaracha tulanet phirtya kulavache fayde konte ahet?
results.answer:

Both natural and organic farming [सेंद्रिय शेती] represent sustainable agricultural models, but they differ significantly. Organic farming [सेंद्रिय शेती] allows the use of certain organic fertilizers [सेंद्रिय खते] and bio-pesticides [जैविक कीटकनाशके] produced outside, whereas natural farming [नैसर्गिक शेती] completely avoids external inputs, relying instead on natural biological products. By emphasizing self-sustaining ecosystems, natural farming [नैसर्गिक शेती] eliminates the dependency on external fertilizers and pesticides, making it a cost-effective and environmentally friendly alternative to conventional and organic farming practices [सेंद्रिय शेती पद्धती]. The differences between conventional farming [पारंपरिक शेती], organic farming [सेंद्रिय शेती] and natural farming [नैसर्गिक शेती] are given in Table 1.1.

**Benefits of the Organic Farming [सेंद्रिय शेती] Method:**

- The natural and biological fertility [प्रजननक्षमता] of the soil [माती] is maintained.
- Environmental balance is maintained.
- The quality of agricultural production [उत्पादन] is enhanced, and storage [साठवण] capacity is increased.
- The population of friendly insects and beneficial organisms grows rapidly, preventing the infestation of harmful insects.
- The rate of soil erosion [जमीनीची धुप] is reduced.
- Livestock [पशुधन] can be used extensively for farming [शेती करणे].
- The water-holding capacity [पाणी धरणक्षमता / पाणी धारण क्षमता] of the soil [माती] increases.
- Agricultural produce from organic farming [सेंद्रिय शेती] is free of the toxic residue of insecticide [कीटकनाशक] and fungicide [बुरशीनाशक] substances.

**Testing, Inspection, and Certification for Organic Farming [सेंद्रिय शेती]:**

The most important component of organic farming [सेंद्रिय शेती] and the center point is certification. Certification is a guarantee to the customer of the quality of the organically produced agricultural produce that has been processed. To determine that the farmers' produce is indeed organic [सेंद्रिय], it is necessary to label the agricultural produce with a seal approved by a government-approved organization. For this, inspectors and officers of these organizations visit the plots of organic farming [सेंद्रिय शेती] from time to time, and major stages of organic production [सेंद्रिय उत्पादन] are performed under the supervision of the inspectors. Organic standards [सेंद्रिय मानके] are the parameters for quality and standard control [नियंत्रण] in the organic farming [सेंद्रिय शेती] industry. In India, since October 1, 2001, certification from a licensed certification agency has been required for exporting produce as organic [सेंद्रिय]. The India Organic [सेंद्रिय] logo was certified on July 26, 2002. The Ministry of Commerce of the country announced the National Program for Organic [सेंद्रिय] on May 7, 2003. Currently, six agencies have been approved for certification. The Agricultural and Processed Food Products Export [निर्यात] Authority is a major certification agency, and the following four agencies have been authorized to certify under its authority:

- Institute of Marketology, Bangalore.
- S.K.A.L. India, Bangalore.
- Ecocert, Germany.
- S.G.S. India Pvt. Ltd., Gurgaon.

**Transition Period:**

The period from the start of organic farming [सेंद्रिय शेती] to the certification of the agricultural produce as organic [सेंद्रिय] is called the transition period. This period can range from 1-3 years. It is mandatory to free the soil [माती] from agricultural chemicals [कृषी रसायने]. During this transition period, the agricultural produce can be sold under the Under Conversion label of the certification agency.

**Sowing [पेरणी] Time  
**It is very important to sow [मादी डुक्कर] safflower [करडई] at the right time. Early sowing [पेरणी] (first fortnight of September) causes heavy damage to the crop [पीक] due to the fungal disease [बुरशीजन्य रोग] leaf spot [पानावरील ठिपके / पानांवरील ठिपके] and consequently reduces the yield [उत्पादन]. On the other hand, if sowing [पेरणी] is done late (after the second week of October), the aphid infestation [मावा प्रादुर्भाव / मावा कीटकांचा प्रादुर्भाव] occurs on a large scale as the crop growth stage [पीक वृद्धी अवस्था] comes during the cold season [हंगाम/ऋतू] and the yield [उत्पादन] decreases. Therefore, it is recommended to sow [मादी डुक्कर] safflower [करडई] from the second fortnight of September to the first week of October. Irrigated safflower [करडई] should be sown by the end of October.

**Sowing [पेरणी] Distance  
**In rainfed area [कोरडवाहूक्षेत्र], the distance between two rows should be 45 cm and the distance between two plants should be 20 cm.

**Sowing Method [बियाणे पेरण्याची पद्धत]  
**Safflower [करडई], being an oilseed [तेलबिया] crop [पीक], should be sown with a two-tined seed drill [बियाणे पेरणी यंत्र] so that fertilizer [खत] and seed [बियाणे] can be sown at the same time.  
Seed Rate [बियाण्याची प्रमाण]: 10 to 12 kg of seed [बियाणे] per hectare is sufficient.

**The seed [बियाणे] should be treated with Azetobacter at 25 grams and P.S.B. at 25 grams per kg. To control [नियंत्रण] seed [बियाणे]-borne as well as soil [माती]-borne fungal diseases, the safflower [करडई] seed [बियाणे] should be treated with Trichoderma [ट्रायकोडर्मा] bio-fungicide [बुरशीनाशक] at 10 grams per kg of seed [बियाणे] before sowing [पेरणी].

**Research conducted under the All India Oilseed [तेलबिया] Safflower [करडई] Research Project, Solapur has shown that intercropping [आंतरपीक] methods of Gram [हरभरा] + Safflower [करडई] (6:3) and Linseed [जवस] + Safflower [करडई] (4:2) are beneficial.

For irrigated safflower [करडई] crop [पीक], 30 kg nitrogen [नत्र] (65.2 kg urea [यूरिया]) + 15 kg phosphorus [स्फुरद] (94 kg single super phosphate) should be given per acre.

4.Potassium [पालाश]:

Potassium [पालाश] is the third most abundant mineral in the animal body and serves as the primary intracellular ion, with concentrations ranging from 100 to 160 mmol/L in body tissues. It plays a crucial role in maintaining nerve and muscle excitability, as well as regulating the body's water balance [जल संतुलन] and acid-base equilibrium. Potassium [पालाश] is also involved in cellular respiration [श्वसन] through the chloride shift and influences various intracellular processes, including enzyme function and muscle contraction.

For herbivores, potassium [पालाश] deficiency is uncommon, as most forages naturally contain adequate levels of this mineral. However, when deficiency does occur, it can lead to symptoms [लक्षणे] such as muscle weakness [अशक्तपणा / दुर्बलता], stiffness, paralysis, and intracellular acidosis. In potassium [पालाश]-deficient animals, the reduction of potassium [पालाश] in milk [दूध] is more pronounced than in plasma [प्लाझ्मा]. Dairy [दुग्धव्यवसाय] calves with marginal potassium [पालाश] deficiency may show decreased appetite [भूक] and reduced weight gain [वजन वाढ], even when plasma [प्लाझ्मा] potassium [पालाश] levels appear normal.

The identification of methionine, an essential amino acid containing one sulphur [गंधक] atom per molecule, highlighted the importance of sulphur [गंधक] as a dietary nutrient [पोषक घटक]. Sulphur [गंधक] is found in connective tissues as sulphate and is a component of the natural anticoagulant [रक्त गोठणे प्रतिबंधक द्रव्य] heparin [हेपारिन]. Depending on the extent of the disease [रोग] condition, intravenous isotonic 1.3-1.4 % solution of sodium bicarbonate solution is given as treatment [उपचार].

Alkalosis

Elevated blood [रक्त] pH is the hallmark of alkalemia, also known as metabolic alkalosis, which is often driven on by excessive acid loss, increased absorption of alkali, or a carbon dioxide deficiency.

Etiology [रोगकारण]

Metabolic alkalosis commonly arises from condition like abomasal atony, which may occur due to abomasal impaction. Under these events, potassium [पालाश] and hydrochloric acid are continuously secreted into the abomasum, resulting in hyperchloremic and hypokalaemia alkalosis. Furthermore, metabolic alkalosis can cause a shift in potassium [पालाश] from extracellular to intracellular locations, which may exacerbate hypokalaemia even in cases where the body potassium [पालाश] levels are acceptable.

Animal alkalosis may be challenging to diagnose due to a lack of specific clinical symptoms [लक्षणे]. It frequently causes convulsions, tetany, tremors in the muscles, and shallow respirations. In more severe phases, dyspnoea and hyperpnea can appear.

निंबोळी पेंडीचा वापर जमिनीच्या आरोग्यासाठी खूप सोपा आहे — ओल्या मातीत मिसळून देता, आणि युरियासारख्या नत्रयुक्त खताने एकत्र वापरला तर फायदा जास्त येतो.

**माती/जमीन:**
- निंबोळी पेंड सेंद्रिय पदार्थात ५% नत्र असते आणि रासायनिक खतांचा परिणाम सुधारतो; प्रत्येक पिकापूर्वी (ओलेपणा असताना) मातीत मिसळा.

**खत/पोषण व्यवस्थापन:**
- युरिया + निंबोळी पेंड यांचं प्रमाण ५:१ ठेवा (उदा. युरिया पाच भाग आणि निंबोळी पेंड एक भाग).
- कडूलिंबाचा पेंढ दर हेक्टर २० क्विंटल अशा दोन वेगळ्या वेळी (जून व डिसेंबर) मातीत देण्याची शिफारस केलेली आहे.

**इतर सल्ला:**
- जीवाणू खते किंवा ट्रायकोडर्मासोबत निंबोळी पेंड मातीत दिला तर ओलाव्यात हानिकारक कीटक कमी होण्यास मदत होते.

**स्रोत: महात्मा फुले कृषी विद्यापीठ (एम.पी.के.व्ही.), वसंतराव नाईक मराठवाडा कृषी विद्यापीठ (व्ही.एन.एम.ए.यू.), डॉ. पंजाबराव देशमुख कृषी विद्यापीठ (पी.डी.के.व्ही.)**

तुम्ही कोणत्या पिकासाठी (भात, ऊस, गहू इ.) निंबोळी पेंड वापरायचा आहे?

Betel vine is a cash crop [नगदी पीक] in Vidarbha and betel vine orchards are mostly found in Akola, Amravati, Buldhana, and Yavatmal districts. **Integrated Disease Management [एकात्मिक रोग व्यवस्थापन] Package**

**Package - 1:**

a) **Trichoderma [ट्रायकोडर्मा] (Seed Treatment [बियाणे प्रक्रिया / बीज प्रक्रिया] + Soil [माती] Application [वापर/फवारणी]):**

1. Mix 1 kg of Trichoderma [ट्रायकोडर्मा] with 09 liters of water [पाणी] and dip the seedlings in this solution before planting.
2. Mix 1 kg of Trichoderma [ट्रायकोडर्मा] powder with 09 kg of well-decomposed manure [खत] and apply 100 grams of this mixture per square meter to the soil [माती] near the roots of the vines [वेली] at monthly intervals (from June to January).

b) **Neem Cake [कडुलिंबाचा पेंढ]:** Apply 20 quintals of neem cake [कडुलिंबाचा पेंढ] per hectare in the soil [माती], divided into two applications in June and December.

c) **Salicylic Acid:** Spray 10 ppm salicylic acid on the vines [वेली] twice a year (in June and December).

d) **Chemical Fertilizers [रासायनिक खते]:** Apply Nitrogen [नत्र], Phosphorus [स्फुरद], and Potash in the ratio [प्रमाण] of 100:50:50. (Apply Phosphorus [स्फुरद] and Potash together initially in June, while Nitrogen [नत्र] should be applied in the form of ammonium sulphate in two divided doses (in June and December)).

e) **Irrigation Management [सिंचन व्यवस्थापन]:** Use drip irrigation [ठिबक सिंचन] for irrigation management [सिंचन व्यवस्थापन].

**Package - 2:**

a) Mix 10 kg of Trichoderma [ट्रायकोडर्मा] harzianum in 20 quintals/ha of Neem cake [कडुलिंबाचा पेंढ] and apply it in June and December in two parts.

b) Mix 5 tons each of manure [खत] and alluvial soil [माती] plus 2 tons of goat [शेळी] manure [खत] plus 10 kg of phosphorus [स्फुरद] dissolving bacteria [जीवाणू] per hectare and apply it collectively in July.

c) Plant [रोप/वनस्पती] Zendu (Marigold [झेंडू]) seedlings in the betel vine and betel leaf [विडा पान] fields after one row in July.

**Use of Pheromone Traps [फेरोमोन सापळे] for Pest Management [कीड व्यवस्थापन]**

**Insects release a mixture of chemicals with a specific odor from their bodies to communicate with members of their own species [प्रजाती]. These chemicals create a specific reaction in them and perform the function of communication, and are called pheromones. Currently, artificially produced pheromones of some insects are available in the market for sale.**

**Pheromones are widely used to find efficient mates for mating. Insects of the opposite sex are attracted to each other for mating by its smell. We can use it for the following reasons.**

1. **To monitor pests through traps [सापळे].**
2. **To destroy the pests by catching moths in large numbers in the trap.**
3. **To prevent reproduction by creating obstacles in the mating of insects.**

**Pheromone traps [फेरोमोन सापळे] are mainly used to initiate pest control [कीड नियंत्रण] operations in various crops. For monitoring [निरीक्षण/देखरेख], 5 traps [सापळे] are sufficient in one hectare of area. A number is fixed as to how many moths should be trapped in the trap to start crop protection [पीक संरक्षण] measures. For example, if an average of 8 to 10 moths of pod borer [शेंगा पोखरणारी अळी] are found continuously for 2-3 days in each trap, then it is necessary to immediately implement pest control [कीड नियंत्रण] measures.**

**Pheromone traps [फेरोमोन सापळे] can be used to catch moths when the number of pests is very low. For this, 10 to 12 pheromone traps [फेरोमोन सापळे] are installed in one hectare of area and moths are caught in large numbers, which helps in reducing further reproduction. To create obstacles in the mating of insects, the subtle odor of sex pheromone [फेरोमोन] chemical spreads in the atmosphere through the trap. Due to this, the insects are deceived while searching for a mate for mating. As a result, there is no reproduction because they do not mate. Therefore, a decrease in the number of insects in the next generation is observed. Currently, pheromone traps [फेरोमोन सापळे] for pod borer [शेंगा पोखरणारी अळी], Spodoptera larva on soybean [सोयाबीन], larvae on eggplant, okra [भेंडी], cabbage [कोबी / पत्ता कोबी], sugarcane [ऊस], cotton [कापूस], and fruit fly [फळमाशी] are available in the market. Their price is Rs. 50 to 125 per trap. Pheromones are changed every 2 to 3 weeks. Their price is Rs. 10 to 50 per lure [आमिष].**
